Enterprise Edition.note: Prose occasionally uses 엔터프라이즈 에디션; keep the English name for the edition itself.

Channels.note: Product name; the common noun 'channel' is 채널.

Playbooks.note: Product name; the common noun 'playbook' is 플레이북.

Calls.note: Product name; the common noun 'call' is 통화.

Markdown.note: 마크다운 is acceptable in prose, but existing UI keeps the English form.

MFA.note: When spelled out, 'multi-factor authentication' is 다단계 인증 in existing strings.

System Console.note: Majority rendering (32 vs 6); a few legacy strings use 관리자 도구 — do not reuse it.

post.note: Repo usage is mixed (메시지/글/게시물/게시글). Use 게시물 to keep the noun distinct from message = 메시지; 글 appears in some admin labels.

thread.note: Majority rendering (40 vs 22); older strings use 글타래 — prefer 스레드 for consistency.

reply.note: Noun and verb stem (답글, 답글 달기). 댓글/회신 appear in a few legacy strings; prefer 답글.

direct message.note: Majority rendering (30 vs 18); some headings/legacy strings use 개인 메시지. DM abbreviation can stay DM.

mention.note: Verb: 멘션하다. 언급 appears in some admin strings; prefer 멘션.

pin.note: Verb: 고정하다; pinned messages = 고정된 메시지; unpin = 고정 해제. One legacy string uses 공지하기 — avoid.

saved messages.note: Repo is inconsistent (중요 메시지, 보관된 메시지 in legacy strings); save = 저장, unsave = 저장 해제.

draft.note: Repo splits between 초안 (10) and 임시 글 (8); use 초안 consistently.

scheduled post.note: Also rendered 예약된 게시물 in admin strings; prefer 예약된 메시지.

emoji.note: 이모티콘 is nearly as frequent in the repo, but 이모지 is the accurate Korean term for emoji; use it consistently.

reaction.note: Verb: 반응 추가하다. 리액션 appears in a few strings; prefer 반응.

away.note: Existing labels vary between 자리비움 and 자리 비움; standard spacing is 자리 비움.

member.note: Majority rendering (103 vs 32 멤버, 48 회원); use 구성원.

sign in.note: Verb: 로그인하다. Both 'sign in' and 'log in' map to 로그인.

sign out.note: Verb: 로그아웃하다. Both 'sign out' and 'log out' map to 로그아웃.

join.note: Verb: 참여하다 for channels; teams often use 가입(하다) in existing strings — either is fine per object, but keep channels = 참여.

leave.note: Verb: 나가다. Repo mixes 떠나기/탈퇴/나가기; prefer 나가기 (탈퇴 acceptable for teams).

archive.note: Verb: 보관하다; archived = 보관됨. A few strings use 아카이브 — prefer 보관.

mute.note: Channel-mute strings often render 'Mute Channel' as 채널 알림 끄기; plain Mute label is 음소거. Keep Calls microphone mute also 음소거.

follow.note: Verb: 팔로우하다. Legacy strings use 구독/지켜보기; prefer 팔로우 (matches follower = 팔로워).

unfollow.note: Legacy strings use 구독 해제; prefer 팔로우 해제.

favorite.note: Verb: 즐겨찾기에 추가하다; unfavorite = 즐겨찾기에서 제거.

webhook.note: Repo is inconsistent (many strings keep English 'Webhook'); standardize on 웹훅.

incoming webhook.note: Repo mostly leaves this in English; 들어오는 웹훅 mirrors the existing 나가는 웹훅. 수신 웹훅 is an acceptable alternative if used consistently with 발신 웹훅.

outgoing webhook.note: Existing rendering; pair with 들어오는 웹훅.

scheme.note: Majority rendering; avoid 스킴/계획 seen in a few strings.

trial.note: Majority rendering (45 vs 7 체험판); free trial = 무료 평가판.

workspace.note: Majority rendering (33 vs 22 작업 공간); prefer 워크스페이스.

invitation.note: For the email/link itself, 초대장 or 초대 링크 may be used where the sentence needs a concrete object.

unread.note: Attributive: 읽지 않은 (e.g. 읽지 않은 메시지).

private channel.note: Never 개인 채널 (seen once in a legacy string).

channel purpose.note: Some legacy strings use 설명; prefer 목적.

persistent notification.note: Majority rendering; 지속 알림 appears in a few strings — prefer 영구 알림.

recap.note: No existing translation; 리캡 keeps it distinct from summary = 요약. If a descriptive form is needed, 요약 정리 works in prose.

agent.note: One legacy string mistranslates Agents as 상담원 (customer-service agent) — avoid.

burn-on-read.note: No existing translation; label form (BURN ON READ) can be 읽은 후 삭제됨.

announcement banner.note: Repo also has 알림 배너/시스템 전체 알림; standardize on 공지 배너.

profile.note: Legacy menu items use 계정 설정 for Profile; the current convention is 프로필.

display name.note: 표시명 appears in some short labels; prefer 표시 이름.

collapsed reply threads.note: No existing translation; keep 스레드 (not 글타래) to match the thread glossary entry.

compliance export.note: 규정 준수 내보내기 also appears; prefer 컴플라이언스 내보내기 (majority).

access control.note: Policy: 액세스 제어 정책; attribute-based access control = 속성 기반 액세스 제어.

Town Square.note: Grounded in the only existing rendering; write with a space (타운 스퀘어), not 타운스퀘어.

Off-Topic.note: Grounded in the only existing rendering.
